newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mayne mulls A$2 bln health buy-paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mayne mulls A$2 bln health buy-paper.

text.p: Australian transport, security and healthcare group Mayne Nickless Ltd has made the short list of bidders to buy Europe's largest private hospital operator, General de Sante, the Sydney Morning Herald reported on Friday.
"It is understood Mayne has made the short-list of companies to purchase General de Sante from French utilities giant General de Eaux," the newspaper reported.
It said the cost of the bid would be about A$2 billion.
The newspaper said funds for the bid would be generated by the sale of Mayne's 25 percent stake in Australia's second largest telecommunications company, Optus Communications.
The stake has been valued by the market at between A$750 million and A$1 billion.
Mayne on Thursday reported that its net profit fell 13.8 percent to A$43.14 million for the six months to end December.
